description: Public Instagram profile as a logged-out visitor sees it: ID, username, full name, bio, bio links, verified and private flags, exact follower and following counts, post count and profile picture. Business category and reel/highlight counts are null while Instagram keeps its profile JSON closed to logged-out clients (since 4 Nov 2026). Unknown usernames return 404; a blocked or failed fetch returns 503 (not charged). Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_instagram_highlights when you need Story highlights of a public Instagram profile: highlight; social_instagram_related_profiles when you need Accounts Instagram suggests as related to a public profile. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

username.description: Instagram username (with or without @) or instagram.com/<user> URL
